d: Interpay builds the retail payment software that banks and merchants across Saudi Arabia depend on: POS and SoftPOS acceptance, e-commerce gateways, payment switching and merchant services. Our products handle cardholder data under SAMA regulation and PCI security standards, and they run around the clock.

Interpay's backend platform authorises, routes and settles card transactions at scale. As a Backend Engineer (.NET), you'll build and operate the services behind it: maintaining established ASP.NET applications on Windows and SQL Server, and building cloud-native services on modern .NET in Linux containers on Kubernetes. You'll report to the Development Manager.

4+ years of backend development, with production systems delivered
Strong C# across .NET Framework / ASP.NET and current .NET
ASP.NET MVC, dependency injection and repository patterns
Building and running services in Linux containers with Docker and Kubernetes
Solid SQL Server: schema design, stored procedures, indexing and query tuning

Agile delivery, and Git with pull-request and code-review workflows
Secure coding and the OWASP Top 10
Enough HTML5 and CSS3 to support server-rendered views
Willing and eligible to work on-site in Riyadh
Payments, fintech or banking experience, especially switching, acquiring, POS or e-commerce processing
ISO 8583 message construction, parsing and host interface development
EMV, tokenisation, HSM integration, DUKPT or TR-31 key blocks

Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms

Full-time, on-site at our Riyadh office. You may join an on-call rotation and occasionally work outside standard hours to support production releases and incidents.

Fairmont Palliser | A Legacy of Excellence, A Future of Possibility

For over a century, Fairmont Palliser has stood as Calgary’s most iconic hotel—a symbol of timeless elegance, heartfelt hospitality, and deep community roots. Since opening in 1914, we have welcomed dignitaries, trailblazers, and generations of guests with impeccable service and unforgettable experiences.

Our story is woven into the fabric of Calgary’s history, and our people are at the heart of it all. At Fairmont Palliser, we believe in creating a workplace where tradition meets innovation, where careers are cultivated, and where everyone is empowered to thrive. Whether you are just beginning your journey in hospitality or bringing years of experience to the table, here you will find a team that values connection, excellence, and purpose.
Join us in delivering elevated experiences and be part of a legacy that continues to shape the future of hospitality in Calgary.

At Fairmont, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager to join our growing organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this pivotal role, you will lead our sales team to achieve ambitious revenue targets while building and maintaining strong client relationships. As Sales Manager, you will be the driving force behind our sales strategy, inspiring your team to deliver exceptional results and fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Reporting to senior leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape our market presence and contribute to our organization's sustained growth and success.
Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies to achieve and exceed revenue targets and organizational goals
